meta.title: Dysphoria — Jy Yeüng
meta.description: Dysphoria is a fifteen-image self-portrait series built like an album, where each frame plays as its own track. Black and white audiovisual document with soundtrack.

intro.heading: Dysphoria
intro.body: Dysphoria is a fifteen-image self-portrait series built like an album, where each frame plays as its own track. Shot in stark black and white, the work resists the usual arc toward healing or resolution. It stays inside the reaction itself — documenting an internal state rather than explaining it away. Contortion, light as current, and abrupt endings stand in for feelings that keep living in the body until they are given somewhere else to go. What remains is not a cure, but a record: an audiovisual document paired with a soundtrack, still living where it was found.

tracks.title: The Host
tracks.liner: Dysphoria as something that keeps living in the body until it is given somewhere else to go.
tracks.caption:
There's a feeling, I can't sustain it anymore. I had to find a host, a medium to let it out. Or else, it'll parasitize my brain forever.

Sometimes I find it easier to express myself through visuals. The other times, words and the sound of my soundtrack playlist do the trick.

This is the host for my parasites.

tracks.title: Grinding Grit onto Grief
tracks.liner: The body reaches for the ground and never arrives.
tracks.caption: My pen always runs out of ink when I have something to say. So I grabbed another pen, turns out I'm not writing the same thing anymore.

tracks.title: A Charlatan's Curse
tracks.liner: Imposter air. The exhaustion of doubting the hand that made the picture.
tracks.caption:
I feel like I've been cursed from the start. All the indecisiveness, the perfectionism, my sensitivity to external feelings... they all lead to this wreck.

I wanna break it so so bad.

tracks.title: Funnel
tracks.liner: White light held like current. The mind routed and rerouted.
tracks.caption:
You know those pipe-connecting games? I think using the power you've just reclaimed is kind of like that. You have to be very strategic and resourceful to flip all the switches and valves to get it, drip by drip, to the right place.

And here's the hardest part, don’t let anyone take that away from you.

tracks.title: X-OVER
tracks.liner: Half a face under the drape. One eye in the seam between light and shadow.
tracks.caption:
To me, the title is pronounced as “crossover”, but you can say it in any way you prefer. Just insert your favourite profanity or word into the unknown variable, X.

The creative freedom is all yours.

tracks.title: Pin
tracks.liner: Maybe it’s dumb to pin significance onto every little thing — but we still do.
tracks.caption: "Maybe it's dumb to pin significance into every little thing — but we still do."

tracks.title: trance
tracks.titleDisplay: t r a n c e
tracks.liner: Same current, thinner air. Hands as the wire the feeling runs through.
tracks.caption:
"An alteration in perspective does not equate to change. Action does."

This one is about those moments of wanting to hit yourself figuratively and (meta)physically, in different formats, fonts and wordings, again and again, just to get the point across.

tracks.title: Sinister & Dexter
tracks.liner: Left and right, white and black, glance and turn.
tracks.caption:
In Latin, the words "Sinister" and "Dexter" stand for "left" and "right," respectively. One day, "sinister" became a negative term simply because the world decided that the minority of left-handed people should be associated with evil and harm.

Does this still sound familiar in modern day society?

tracks.title: Grooving Grunge in Grudges
tracks.liner: The stretch pushed further. It hurts — and reminds you that you are still here.
tracks.caption: Stretching emotions to infinity — just to experience every beauty and terror along the way.

tracks.title: Unquenchable Thirst
tracks.caption:
I have an unhealthy obsession with loneliness.
Wanting to disappear all the time.
Everything is so draining.
They said don't believe everything your brain told you, but I've tasted it... I could be so much more in this way.

And it's not some cheap dopamine.

tracks.title: One day
tracks.liner: Near-dark. A short fear of losing the light of reality.
tracks.caption:
One day, I stopped fighting for truth.
One day, I lost light of reality.

tracks.title: Placebo
tracks.liner: The fading returns of things once loved without effort.
tracks.caption:
"The universe won't wait for you."

Time slips away when you're dwelling in your own thoughts.

Pop culture, music, games, tech and film — they're losing their power to lift my mood. Songs feel shorter now, technically and metaphorically, because the mind is occupied by a million things at once.

tracks.title: Where does the line end?
tracks.liner: Whether forgiveness only becomes real once a life is over.
tracks.caption:
My grandpa was on his deathbed.
He went through all his regrets while the heart monitor beeped, slowly.

Life is like untangling a messy cable.
The more you untangle it, the more peace you make with yourself.
You pull at each knot one by one.
Sometimes it just gets knottier.
And when you finally get the cord straight —
that’s where your lifeline falls still.

tracks.title: Sad People, Big Ambitions
tracks.liner: Title and image already say it. Nothing to add.
tracks.caption: (instrumental break)

tracks.title: The Divided Line
tracks.liner: An abrupt stop on purpose. The record ends before the feeling does.
tracks.caption:
This project was never about healing.
The feeling was always there.
I always knew it would close in 15 posts.
And now, this is the abrupt end. 🔌
